name: com.cryptocasinomedia/newsroom
title: CryptoCasinoMedia Newsroom
description: Live crypto casino & iGaming news search, article metadata, and newsroom metrics via MCP.

tools.name: get_newsroom_metrics
tools.description: Retrieve live CryptoCasinoMedia newsroom metrics including total indexed articles, active editorial count, historical wire archive count, category breakdown, and latest published headlines.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search across 1,270+ CryptoCasinoMedia editorial reports and PR Newswire / GlobeNewswire iGaming press releases by keyword, company, or category.

query.description: Keyword, operator name, topic, or headline phrase to search for.

category.description: Optional category filter (crypto-casinos, sportsbook, regulation, payments, sweepstakes).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10, max 50).

tools.name: get_article_details
tools.description: Retrieve full structured metadata, canonical URL, image attribution, summary, and full body text for a specific CryptoCasinoMedia article by slug.

slug.description: Exact article URL slug (e.g., from search_articles).
